---
title: "A Typst theme for the window"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

```{=typst}
#state("code-window-theme").update((
  border: rgb("#ff0000"),
  stroke-dash: "dashed",
  body-inset: 40pt,
))
```

The theme above stands in for a template, which sets the same state before
the body. The window below takes its border and its inset from the theme.

```{.python filename="a.py"}
x = 1
```

The block below has no window, so it keeps the usual inset.

```{.python code-window-enabled="false"}
y = 2
```
